# MiniMax H3

> minimaxh3.pro is an independent third-party online workspace for generating AI videos with MiniMax H3. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by MiniMax.

## Product
- [MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator](https://minimaxh3.pro/): Text, first/last frame, and multimodal reference video generation.
- [Pricing](https://minimaxh3.pro/pricing): Monthly plans, credit allowances, and one-time credit packages.
- [About](https://minimaxh3.pro/about): Operator, independence statement, billing model, data responsibilities, and support.
- [Contact](https://minimaxh3.pro/contact): Account, billing, generation, and saved-video support.
- [Machine-readable pricing](https://minimaxh3.pro/pricing.md): Current plans, credit packages, generation rates, and validity rules.

## Key facts
- Service: Independent third-party MiniMax H3 video generation workspace
- Language: English
- Generation modes: Text to video, first and last frame, and multimodal reference
- Output duration: 4–15 seconds
- Resolution options: 768P and 2K
- Support: support@minimaxh3.pro
- Affiliation: Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by MiniMax
